response.sql: WITH product_stats AS (SELECT p.product_id, pc.product_type_description, AVG(oi.product_quantity * 1.0) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS item_count FROM Products AS p JOIN Product_Categories AS pc ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code LEFT JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, pc.product_type_description), product_shares AS (SELECT product_type_description, avg_quantity, item_count, COALESCE(item_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(item_count) OVER (), 0), 0) AS item_share FROM product_stats), type_averages AS (SELECT product_type_description, AVG(avg_quantity) AS avg_quantity, AVG(item_count) AS avg_item_count, AVG(item_share) AS avg_item_share FROM product_shares GROUP BY product_type_description) SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS avg_quantity, AVG(avg_item_count) AS avg_order_item_count, AVG(avg_item_share) AS avg_order_item_share FROM type_averages

assumptions.assumption: Non-null product_quantity values contain numeric text.
